meta.name: artifact-summary-standard
meta.description: Enforce a consistent delivery summary containing changed files, run steps, tests, and rollback instructions. Use at the end of every skill-driven task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成包含变更文件、运行步骤、测试和回滚说明的交付摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次技能驱动任务后都需要一份标准化的交付摘要
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a consistent delivery summary after every skill-driven task

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在每次技能驱动的任务结束时，自动生成一份包含变更文件、运行步骤、测试和回滚指令的交付摘要。
howto.when: 在每次技能驱动的任务结束时触发，用于标准化交接和调试上下文。

say.text: 请生成这次修改的交付摘要。
say.note: Claude 会输出包含变更文件、运行步骤等内容的摘要。

say.text: 帮我检查一下这次任务的摘要是否完整。
say.note: Claude 会验证摘要的各个部分是否齐全。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically generates a delivery summary containing changed files, run steps, tests, and rollback instructions at the end of every skill-driven task.
howto.when_en: Triggered at the end of every skill-driven task to standardize handoff and debugging context.

say_en.text: Please generate a delivery summary for this change.
say_en.note: Claude will output a summary with changed files, run steps, etc.

say_en.text: Check if the summary for this task is complete.
say_en.note: Claude will verify all sections are present.
